jobs.description:
As a maintenance operator, you are responsible for the preventive and corrective maintenance of production machines. You detect technical faults, solve them independently or report them to your supervisor. You provide technical support to production teams and actively contribute to improvements in installations and working methods. You will also assist in the installation and commissioning of new machines.

Your tasks include:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations

• Resolving mechanical and electrical breakdowns to ensure smooth production

• Providing technical support to operators

• Assisting with new installations (setup, adjustment, parameter settings)

• Proposing improvements to maintenance procedures and technical documentation

• Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental regulations

• The main focus is on mechanics (pneumatics, hydraulics, welding, bearings, compressors, heavy mechanics), with basic knowledge of electricity.

• Technical degree in electromechanics or equivalent through experience

• Initial experience in industrial maintenance is a plus, but motivated juniors are also welcome

• Strong interest in mechanical maintenance (electricity as complementary knowledge)

• Insight into industrial processes and the interaction between machines

• You work safely, accurately, and follow procedures correctly

• You are stress-resistant and can react quickly in case of breakdowns

• You communicate well and enjoy working in a team

• You speak English and French

• You are eager to learn and open to new technologies

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2

• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion

• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation

• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization

• Control systems for robotics

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics

• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

• You can communicate fluently in English

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we are seeking 100% EV Car Technicians.

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification + working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.​

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

What does the job entail?

As a Yard Driver / operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Main responsibilities:

• Shunting: Safely and efficiently maneuvering and moving vehicles from point A to point B across the yard / terminal grounds.
• Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): Carrying out final quality checks before vehicles are dispatched to clients.
• Damage inspection: Checking incoming vehicles at the terminal for any existing damage.
• Periodic maintenance checks: Performing checks such as battery health checks and engine runs.

VG 458/BUOSAP

• driver's license: You have held a valid Category B driver's license for at least 2 years.
• language skills: Very good command (speaking and understanding) of either Dutch or English.
• work ethic: Reliable, punctual, and committed to working with precision and care.
• availability: Available full-time to work in a 2-shift rotation (06:30 - 14:15 / 14:30 - 22:15).
As a yard driver / Operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Working for one of the top players in the logistics market. The company enterprising, competitive, and wants to grow as an organization. That is why they are looking for people who want to grow with them

Jobomschrijving

• You take care of the daily service around airfreight & export shipments
• You have daily contact with customers
• You are responsible for correct invoicing and data quality
• You inform customers of irregularities
• You take all safety & security rules into account

• You have an interest or experience in export or Freight Forwarding
• You have a previous experience in pharma
• You have a Degree in economics/supply chain/...
• You speak fluent English
• You are stress resistant and have a sense of initiative
• You are good at analysing problems and looking for solutions
• You have a valid work permit for Belgium

jobs.description:
Have you always been interested in the world of graphic design? Do you already have experience from previous jobs or studies? Do you live in the Waregem area? 
Then we're looking for you!

We're looking for a Worker in Digital Print for a company that specialises in certified labels. 

What are your tasks? 

• Working with modern digital printing presses
• Refilling materials in the machines
• Carrying out quality checks (colour, finish, quality)
• Preparing print jobs using digital files
• Minor maintenance 

Who are you?

• You have knowledge of graphic design or pressing machines
• You speak English, French or Dutch
• You have your own transport
• You are precise and hard-working

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.
• You have your own transport.
• Experience in this sector is a plus!

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for an experienced 
(partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in life sciences.
 

As a (partially qualified) patent attorney, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients in the broad field of life sciences.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You'll work from our office in Ghent.

You have or are...
 
 

• A Patent Attorney or Partially Qualified Patent Attorney. 

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in a similar role, preferably in the private sector 

• At least a Masters' degree in life sciences. A PhD is a strong plus. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English.

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
 

Your main responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 
 
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 
 
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 
 
• Receiving and processing customs documents 
 
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 
 
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 
 
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status 
 
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum A2 diploma 

• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 

• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 

• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 

• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 

• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 

• Able to work independently and manage priorities

Description

• Team coordination: Coordinate and supervise teams from various departments to ensure the achievement of set goals.
• Client management: Provide excellent customer service and ensure thorough follow-up on client files.
• Project management: Manage and oversee inter-departmental projects, from planning to delivery of results.
• Quality control: Monitor the quality of services provided and track performance using KPIs.
• Event management: Participate in organizing and following up on internal and external events.
• Strategic planning: Contribute to the definition and implementation of marketing strategies for various departments.
• Development and optimization: Develop tools and methods to optimize work processes and improve overall efficiency.
• Data analysis: Analyze operational performance and provide detailed reports with recommendations.
• 
Administrative management: Oversee daily administrative tasks and contribute to the improvement of internal processes.

 

Profile

• Languages: You have an excellent command of French, English, and Dutch.
• Organizational skills: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Communication skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Strategic marketing: Solid knowledge of strategic marketing concepts.
• Leadership: Ability to lead and supervise teams.
• Adaptability: Able to work in a constantly evolving environment.
• IT skills: Proficient in project management software and common office tools.
• Team spirit: Able to collaborate with various departments.
• 
Degree: Hold a bachelor's degree, preferably related to the position.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker (Vast Night)-  Logistics Company in Evergem
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an order picker, you are an essential part of the logistics process. Your responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Picking and preparing orders for shipment

 
 
• 
 
Performing quality checks on goods

 
 
• 
 
Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

 
 
• 
 
Collaborating with colleagues and other departments

 

You will work in a fixed night shift:

 
• 
 
Hours: 10:15 PM – 5:15 AM

 

Candidate Profile

We are looking for motivated order pickers with:

 
• 
 
Experience in a logistics or warehouse environment

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in a fixed night shift

 
 
• 
 
An accurate and structured work approach

 
 
• 
 
Strong communication skills and a team?oriented mindset

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in English

 
 
• 
 
Experience with an electric pallet truck (BT) or a valid BT certificate

Job Description – Your Responsibilities

As a waste handler & industrial cleaner, you are responsible for maintaining a clean and safe warehouse. Your tasks include:

 
• 
 
Carrying cardboard and waste from picking areas to the correct containers

 
 
• 
 
Cleaning the warehouse and work zones

 
 
• 
 
Cleaning equipment and installations

 
 
• 
 
Contributing to a tidy, safe, and organized work environment

 

Working Hours

You can work in:

 
• 
 
Two?shift system

 
 
• 
 
Early shift: 05:15 – 13:45 (Friday until 12:45)

 
 
• 
 
Late shift: 13:45 – 22:15 (Friday until 20:15)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Fixed night shift

 
 
• 
 
22:15 – 05:15 (Friday until 02:45)

 
 
 

Candidate Profile – Your Skills

We are looking for candidates who:

 
• 
 
Are physically fit and not afraid to roll up their sleeves

 
 
• 
 
Speak and understand Dutch or English well

 
 
• 
 
Are reliable, accurate, and true team players

 
 
• 
 
Have experience in industrial cleaning (a plus, but not required)

Job Description

What will your day look like?

As a loader/unloader, you play an essential role in the warehouse operations. Your main responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Loading and unloading trucks

 
 
• 
 
Handling and lifting heavy packages (physical fitness required)

 
 
• 
 
Working in a fast?paced and dynamic environment

 
 
• 
 
Supporting warehouse activities during day shifts and rotating shifts

 

In the long term, you will have the opportunity to learn how to operate a forklift and/or reach truck, offering great potential for growth.

Candidate Profile

Our ideal loader/unloader has:

 
• 
 
Good physical condition

 
 
• 
 
Experience with BT equipment (certificate is a strong plus)

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in shifts and occasional night shifts

 
 
• 
 
A hands?on mentality and proactive attitude

 
 
• 
 
Enjoyment in working in a dynamic logistics environment

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in Dutch or English

As a Team Leader, you are the right-hand person of the Supervisor and lead a team of approximately 12 warehouse operators. You ensure that all rules and procedures related to cleanliness, safety, and quality are followed, and that the warehouse is always maintained to the highest standards.

You work closely alongside your team on the warehouse equipment and are primarily responsible for operational leadership and guidance. You collaborate closely with the Supervisor, who is your direct manager.

What does our ideal Team Leader look like?

As a Team Leader, you are fluent in Dutch and have strong communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is considered an asset. Ideally, you have experience working in a logistics warehouse environment and have already held a supervisory or leadership role.

You are a team player who is accurate, independent, positive-minded, and driven to achieve results. You possess the necessary leadership skills to motivate and guide your team effectively, and you hold a valid forklift or reach truck certificate.

high-tech visualization solutions for the world’s most demanding sectors: 
Avionics, 
Air Traffic Control and 
Defense & Security markets.

nurtures an existing customer relationship and sales funnel, spread over multiple business divisions of Kongsberg Gruppen A.S.
 

 
 

Main region of focus will be Norway.
 

 
 

Supported by product management, program management, customer service and sales administration teams, the Key Account Manager is responsible for 
successfully implementing the ScioTeq sales strategy while working closely with Kongsberg procurement, program and technical teams to further enhance the existing funnel, close on current opportunities and deepen the existing collaboration.
 

 
 

Primary Responsibilities
 
 

•  

Further develop the account in line with the objectives set by the Senior Sales Director.
  

•  

Maintain and enhance 
commercial contact with existing customer base and manage the 
entire sales cycle, including product presentations, quotations and contractual negotiations.
  

•  

Establish sales 
action plans to achieve bookings and revenue targets.

timely reporting, including forecasting via CRM.
  

•  

Assess 
competitive products, industry trends and identify market opportunities.
  

•  

Understand and live by ScioTeq’s 
ethics and business conduct policies.

You report to the Sales Director Air Traffic Control, Defense & Security.
  
 

•  

You have a 
master’s degree in engineering or business (master’s degree in business, marketing, engineering or related field desirable) or equivalent by experience
  

•  

You have exceptional 
communication skills with the ability to deliver high-level presentations and communicate at C-Level within DoD/MoD and prime contractor base.

You have at least 7 years of 
sales and marketing experience of multi-level selling in an international technical B2B environment.

European defense landscape (military standards and specifications, government type contracts) is a definite plus.
  

•  

Proven track record of successful year-on-year business growth and demonstrated ability to 
close deals.

Comfortable with 
long sales cycles.
  

•

Ability to 
travel as required, up to 50% or more at given times.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You are a key point of contact on the work floor and maintain an overview of the day-to-day logistics operations. At the same time, you take an active, hands-on role in the work yourself.

 
• 
You operate a forklift, reach truck and pallet truck and assist wherever needed.

 
• 
You maintain an overview of the logistics operations and organise the work to ensure everything runs smoothly.

 
• 
You guide and supervise colleagues in a clear and positive manner.

 
• 
You monitor safety, quality and the correct execution of all activities.

 
• 
You accurately scan labels and storage locations and ensure that all movements of goods are correctly registered.

 
• 
When deviations or unexpected situations occur, you respond quickly and take a practical approach to finding solutions.

 
• 
As a key point of contact on the work floor, you contribute to effective teamwork and cooperation.

 
• 
You help ensure that logistics operations are carried out efficiently and in an organised manner.

Ready to take responsibility, support your team and get the job done? You can read below what we are looking for.

 
• 
You have experience in a logistics or warehouse environment and are familiar with day-to-day warehouse operations.

 
• 
You have experience supervising, guiding or coordinating employees.

 
• 
Working hands-on alongside the team is an important part of this position and is something you are comfortable with.

 
• 
You have practical experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck and hold the required certificates.

 
• 
Experience with a pallet truck is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
• 
You are able to maintain an overview, set priorities and adapt quickly when schedules or circumstances change.

 
• 
You communicate clearly with colleagues and are able to guide employees in a positive manner.

 
• 
You actively monitor safety and quality on the work floor.

 
• 
You communicate well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is important because you will be supervising logistics employees who speak Dutch, English or French.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

You are the day-to-day point of contact on the production floor, making sure the team knows what needs to be done. You keep a close eye on both the employees and the production process.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

 
• 
You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, food safety and hygiene.

 
• 
You keep track of production planning and staffing levels and make adjustments when necessary.

 
• 
You identify operational bottlenecks and look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.

 
• 
You motivate employees, provide feedback and address issues when necessary.

 
• 
You contribute to strong teamwork and a positive working atmosphere.

 
• 
You support new colleagues during their onboarding and training.

 
• 
You work closely with other departments and report on daily operations.

 
• 
When the situation requires it, you are happy to roll up your sleeves and work alongside the team on the production floor.

You keep a cool head when plans change and understand what your team needs to keep moving forward. You are visible and approachable on the production floor, provide clear direction and make adjustments where necessary. Sound like you? Then this could be your dream job!

 
• 
You have experience in the food industry, preferably within a production or packaging environment.

 
• 
Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leading role is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You know how to motivate and coach employees and provide clear, constructive feedback.

 
• 
You communicate clearly, respectfully and assertively.

 
• 
When organising the work, you take both quality and efficiency into account.

 
• 
You are able to set priorities and organise daily activities effectively.

 
• 
You take responsibility and show initiative.

 
• 
Changing circumstances sometimes require quick adjustments, and you are able to respond accordingly.

 
• 
You enjoy being present on the production floor and are willing to work alongside the team when needed.

 
• 
You work daytime hours, but are flexible when necessary.

 
• 
You have a good language of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.

actively contribute to the efficient organisation and operation of the kitchen.

Your responsibilities

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Take ownership of scalable web applications, shape technical architecture and build robust solutions with PHP, Symfony & Vue.js.

Our partner is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen its development team.

You will work on scalable web applications, contribute to key architectural decisions and take ownership of technical topics across the stack.

The position combines hands-on development with architecture, code quality and knowledge sharing in a collaborative environment.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications with PHP & Symfony at the core.
• Contribute to system architecture and solution design, focusing on security, performance, scalability and maintainability.
• Develop APIs and integrations, including asynchronous communication patterns.
• Work across the stack on backend services with PHP/Symfony and frontend features with Vue.js.
• Implement automated testing and collaborate on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Profile
• You have 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer.
• You have strong expertise in PHP & Symfony and a solid understanding of web architecture, design patterns and best practices.
• You are comfortable with MySQL/PostgreSQL, caching solutions and asynchronous or distributed systems concepts.
• You have experience with GitLab CI/CD, modern DevOps practices and Docker.
• You have experience with automated testing and bring strong problem-solving skills in collaborative, agile environments.
• You communicate confidently in English.
• Knowledge of TypeScript, Vue.js or Python is considered an asset.
